chunks.title: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund - Fund Overview & Classification
chunks.content: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund (Direct Plan - Growth Option) is managed by HDFC Asset Management Company Limited under the Equity: Mid Cap category. It is an Open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in mid cap stocks. The fund tracks the NIFTY Midcap 150 TRI benchmark and is classified as 'Very High' risk on the SEBI Riskometer.

metadata.fund_type: Open-ended equity scheme predominantly investing in mid cap stocks

chunks.title: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund - Expense Ratio (TER)
chunks.content: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund Direct Plan - Growth is 0.74% (inclusive of GST).

chunks.title: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund - Exit Load & Holding Duration
chunks.content: An exit load of 1.00% is applicable for units redeemed or switched out within 1 year (365 days) from the date of allotment. No exit load is payable for units redeemed after 1 year.

chunks.title: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund - Minimum SIP & Lump Sum Limits
chunks.content: The minimum SIP investment amount is ₹100 per installment. The minimum lump sum investment amount for initial as well as additional purchases is ₹100.

chunks.title: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund - Statutory Lock-in Period
chunks.content: Nil. This is an open-ended equity fund with no statutory lock-in period.

chunks.title: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund - Mutual Fund Taxation & Capital Gains
chunks.content: STCG is taxed at 20% if redeemed within 12 months. LTCG above ₹1.25 Lakh in a financial year is taxed at 12.5% without indexation if held for more than 12 months.

chunks.title: HDFC Mid-Cap Opportunities Fund - Account Statements & Folio Verification
chunks.content: Account statements and capital gains reports can be downloaded online from the Groww App under Profile > Reports or directly via the HDFC MF online investor portal using your PAN and Folio number. Check registered folio numbers in your Groww mutual funds dashboard or consolidated account statement (CAS).

chunks.title: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund - Fund Overview & Classification
chunks.content: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund (Direct Plan - Growth Option) is managed by HDFC Asset Management Company Limited under the Equity: ELSS / Tax Saver category. It is an An open-ended equity linked saving scheme with a statutory lock-in of 3 years and tax benefit under Section 80C. The fund tracks the NIFTY 500 TRI benchmark and is classified as 'Very High' risk on the SEBI Riskometer.

metadata.fund_type: An open-ended equity linked saving scheme with a statutory lock-in of 3 years and tax benefit under Section 80C

chunks.title: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund - Expense Ratio (TER)
chunks.content: The Total Expense Ratio (TER) for HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund Direct Plan - Growth is 1.09%.

chunks.title: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund - Exit Load & Holding Duration
chunks.content: Nil. No exit load is charged for redemption after the completion of the statutory 3-year lock-in period.

chunks.title: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund - Minimum SIP & Lump Sum Limits
chunks.content: The minimum SIP investment is ₹500 and in multiples of ₹500. The minimum lump sum investment amount is ₹500 for initial as well as additional purchases.

chunks.title: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund - Statutory Lock-in Period
chunks.content: Mandatory 3-year (36 months) lock-in period from the date of allotment for each installment. Units cannot be redeemed, transferred, or switched out during the lock-in period.

chunks.title: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund - Mutual Fund Taxation & Capital Gains
chunks.content: Investments qualify for tax deduction under Section 80C of the Income Tax Act up to ₹1.5 Lakh per financial year. Not applicable as redemption is locked for 3 years. LTCG above ₹1.25 Lakh per financial year upon redemption after 3 years is taxed at 12.5% without indexation.

chunks.title: HDFC ELSS Tax Saver Fund - Account Statements & Folio Verification
chunks.content: Tax saving investment certificates (80C proofs) and account statements can be downloaded via Groww Profile > Reports > Capital Gains & Tax Reports or via HDFC MF website. Check registered folio in Groww dashboard or monthly consolidated account statements (CAS).

chunks.title: Mutual Fund Account Statement Download Procedure
chunks.content: To download mutual fund statements on Groww: Open Groww App > Tap Profile Icon > Select 'Reports' > Choose 'Mutual Fund Statements' or 'Capital Gains Report' > Select Financial Year and email or download PDF. To download statements from HDFC Mutual Fund directly: Visit the official HDFC AMC portal > Navigate to 'Investor Services' > Enter PAN / Folio Number > Authenticate via registered email/mobile OTP > Download Account / Capital Gains Statement. Consolidated Account Statement (CAS) can also be downloaded from CAMS (camsonline.com) or KFintech (kfintech.com) using your registered email and PAN.

chunks.title: Mutual Fund Capital Gains Tax Report Download (ITR Filing)
chunks.content: Used for Income Tax Return (ITR) filing to report Short-Term Capital Gains (STCG) and Long-Term Capital Gains (LTCG). Groww App > Profile > Reports > Capital Gains Report > Select Assessment Year > Download Schedule 112A Excel/PDF.

chunks.title: Mutual Fund Educational & Regulatory Resources
chunks.content: For official investor education and mutual fund guidelines, consult Groww Mutual Funds (https://groww.in/mutual-funds), AMFI Investor Education (https://www.amfiindia.com/investor-corner/knowledge-center), or the SEBI Investor Portal (https://investor.sebi.gov.in). These official portals offer investor guidance, regulatory circulars, and dispute resolution workflows.
